visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and bangs stands in a bright, modern kitchen. She wears a light blue oversized sweatshirt with pink and white text. In the background, a man in a white and blue tie-dye fleece stands by the counter, facing away from the camera. The woman smiles and looks towards the camera while gesturing. (2) The scene shifts to a closer shot of the woman's face as she speaks directly to the camera with a bright expression. The lighting is even and bright. (3) The camera pulls back to a medium shot. The woman points toward the background where the man is still working. She then transitions to a preparation scene, holding a light green cup of liquid and a pink bowl containing sugar. She pours both into a black frying pan on the stove. (4) The woman is now seen holding a clear Hello Kitty-themed plastic pitcher filled with water and ice. She takes a skewer with several red, candied strawberries (Tanghulu) and dips it into the pitcher. She smiles broadly, looking proud of the result. (5) The woman walks into a living room area holding a white plate with two skewers of Tanghulu. A man sits on a gray sofa, looking at his phone. She presents the plate to him. He looks up with a skeptical expression. (6) A close-up shows the man's hands using a metal spoon to tap on the candied strawberries. They appear extremely hard, making a distinct visual impact. (7) The woman sits on the sofa next to the man, leaning in and talking animatedly while gesturing toward the food. The man looks hesitant, leaning away slightly while holding the plate.
